what: Order 09: the three.ws Wyoming voice satellite, verified end to end against a real Home Assistant and a real local voice stack. No fixture, no mock: Home Assistant ran its own wake word, speech recognition, intent handling and text to speech, and the house really changed.

stack.homeAssistant: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable, onboarded and seeded by scripts/home-test-instance.mjs --name sat09
stack.satellite: services/home-satellite, run both in Docker and on the host
stack.wyomingVersion: 1.10.2 (this implementation); the tested Home Assistant ships 1.10.0

homeAssistantSide.integration: Wyoming Protocol lists the satellite as a service named 'Kitchen display', area Kitchen, 8 entities
homeAssistantSide.pipeline: 'three.ws satellite' (01m22aey558ddcyjssesb0095f), set as the preferred assistant

browserClosedMidRun.bound: satellite.js _finishSpeaking: with a viewer attached the played acknowledgement is bounded by the answer's own duration plus a grace period, and the timer always fires, so no browser can block the pipeline

pairing.singleUse: claim #1 -> 201 (satellite created); claim #2 with the same code -> 400 invalid_code
pairing.expiry: code minted with a 15.0 minute ttl, row aged one second into the past, claim -> 400 invalid_code
pairing.oneAnswerForAll: malformed, expired, already-claimed and never-existed all return the same message, so the endpoint is not an oracle for guessing codes

unpairedSatellite.wyoming: answers describe with error {code: 'unpaired', text: 'This three.ws satellite has not been paired...'}
unpairedSatellite.healthz: ok:false with pairing_error 'no pairing code was supplied and no identity has been claimed'
unpairedSatellite.viewer: websocket closed 4401 with that same reason

errorState.how: the whisper container was stopped, so speech to text really failed
errorState.page: badge reads 'speech-to-text failed'; the state is transient and settles back to Ready

docker.ran: docker run with THREE_WS_PAIRING_CODE, claimed the code and came up paired
docker.restart: recreated with no pairing code and came up paired from the /data volume

tests: npx vitest run tests/home-satellite-{protocol,server,pairing}.test.js -> 78 passed (74 before this run, plus 4 covering the two fixes)
fixed: the token role built the whole service before signing, so running it the documented way on the machine already running the satellite died with EADDRINUSE
an unpaired satellite never opened its viewer port, so the /healthz the README promises answered nothing on a fresh install
the README's reproduce section named scripts/provision-home-assistant.mjs, which does not exist
localOnlyArtifacts: the agent's GLB is CORS-refused for a http://127.0.0.1 origin by the R2 bucket, so the captured states show the page's designed no-model fallback rather than a face; the model URL itself resolves and the fallback text is correct
Chromium loops --use-file-for-fake-audio-capture, so an unpadded WAV produces a repeated transcript; the padded WAV in the harness notes avoids it
